findings.summary: Hegseth NDA history pre-Monterey: Per Jane Mayer / New Yorker Dec 2 2024 'Pete Hegseth's Secret History,' a SEVEN-PAGE WHISTLEBLOWER REPORT compiled by former employees of Concerned Veterans for America was sent to CVA senior management in FEBRUARY 2015 detailing Hegseth's sexual misconduct and public-intoxication allegations (including: had to be restrained from joining dancers on stage at Louisiana strip club; ignored female employee's attempted-sexual-assault allegation; in late 2015 Ohio work trip yelled 'Kill all Muslims!' and 'passed out' on party bus and urinated outside hotel). Allegations originated with Jessie Jane Duff, circulated in 2018 when Hegseth was floated for VA Secretary. Per CBS, Hegseth 'signed an NDA and received a six-figure severance payment after leaving CVA' — Parlatore confirmed but called it a 'standard severance package' saying 'They make EVERYONE who leaves CVA sign an NDA.' This means Hegseth had a PRIOR NDA pattern before the 2020 Monterey settlement. Hegseth had also led Vets for Freedom (2007-2010) which was forced into merger with Military Families United over financial mismanagement (raised $8.7M in 2008, spent $9.1M).

Hegseth ethics filings and confirmation: Hegseth filed OGE Form 278e public financial disclosure electronically signed Dec 23 2024, certified Jan 10 2025 (PDF at extapps2.oge.gov, 18 pages, prepared via iText 4.2.0); Periodic Transaction Report (OGE 278-T) certified June 6 2025 (post-confirmation trades). Sen. Warren wrote a January 17 2025 letter demanding Hegseth recuse from Fox News matters for FOUR years (citing Biden-era voluntary 4-year recusals). Confirmation hearing was January 14 2025 (>3 hrs of contentious testimony, Reed: 'you lack the character and composure and competence' - first SecDef Reed has voted against in 8 confirmations). Senate confirmed Hegseth 51-50 on January 24 2025 with VP Vance casting tiebreaker; three Republicans defected (McConnell, Murkowski, Collins). Only the second cabinet confirmation in history requiring VP tiebreaker (the first was DeVos 2017, also broken by Pence).

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth directed 8% annual budget cuts ($50B in FY2026) over 5 years, with funds redirected to 'Trump priorities.' Key policy: 'commercial products and offerings will be the default policy.' Exempted from cuts: missile defense (Golden Dome), nuclear weapons, border ops, submarines, drones, munitions. Categories cut include O&M ($8.1B), IT consulting, social science research, DEI programs. Net effect: traditional defense contractors face cuts while Silicon Valley companies (Palantir, SpaceX, Anduril, OpenAI) positioned to capture redirected spending through new 'commercial-first' procurement. Companies must compete for bigger, longer contracts favoring proven tech companies over new entrants.

No lobbying registrations found. Concerned Veterans for America 990 search returned no results (likely different filing name or Koch network structure).

Hegseth-Feinberg connection documented on LittleSis. Stephen Feinberg (Cerberus Capital founder, Trump Intel Oversight Board Chair) is directly connected to Hegseth. Cerberus owns DynCorp International (defense contractor) and has extensive defense portfolio. This connection is significant because Hegseth as SecDef oversees contracts that benefit Feinberg's portfolio companies. Separately, Hegseth's Koch network connection via CVA (Concerned Veterans for America) is notable: CVA was a Koch-backed organization advocating for VA privatization, and Hegseth was its president before moving to Fox News and then DoD.

Hegseth Pentagon inner circle as of late April 2025: senior advisers Sean Parnell, Patrick Weaver, Ricky Buria, Justin Fulcher (named Apr 25 2025 after Caldwell/Selnick/Carroll suspensions Apr 16 and Kasper's exit Apr 24). Parlatore + brother Phil Hegseth + wife Jennifer Rauchet on Signal chat re: Yemen Houthis strike (March 15).

Hegseth's lifetime FEC giving traces from Manhattan Institute (2007 $250 McCain), to his own Senate run (2012 PETE HEGSETH FOR SENATE, MN), to Fox News attorney (2022 $1000 Ian Smith for Congress); no donations from Hegseth to any Trump-aligned PAC found
findings.detail: FEC donor search 'Pete Hegseth' returned 13 records: (i) 2007-04-26 and 2007-05-23 each $125 to JOHN MCCAIN 2008 INC. as Manhattan Institute Policy Specialist (NYC zip); (ii) 2012 multiple PETE HEGSETH FOR SENATE conduit/refund records re his MN Senate exploratory committee (ActRight conduit, ~$15 total + a $2250 refund from MN GOP); (iii) 2016-09-06 $250 to G RYAN FOR CONGRESS (self-employed author); (iv) 2022-04-28 $1000 to IAN SMITH FOR CONGRESS (Fox News host); (v) 2026-01-09 two micro-donations to ACTBLUE listing employer 'US GOVERNMENT' / occupation 'WARMONGER' -- almost certainly impersonation/satire as he was Secretary of Defense by then. NO direct contributions from Hegseth to Save America, Trump 2024, MAGA Inc, Never Surrender, or any Trump-aligned vehicle. The absence of Hegseth's own FEC giving to Trump's network is notable: he is on the receiving end of the relationship (Defense Secretary nominee) rather than the donor end.

findings.detail: CBS News (Nov 2024) and the New Yorker (Dec 2024) document: (a) seven-page whistleblower report dated Feb 2015 naming Hegseth in sexual-misconduct, public-intoxication, and financial-mismanagement allegations, including a 2014 Louisiana strip-club incident in which Hegseth had to be physically restrained and a female employee was reportedly assaulted by a colleague; (b) the female employee accepted payment in exchange for signing an NDA; (c) Jessie Jane Duff (CVA's Senior Military Adviser 2013-2016) is the originating complainant and was fired from CVA after the report surfaced; (d) report was 'privately circulated to broader Republican circles' in 2018 when Hegseth was floated for VA Secretary; (e) Hegseth signed his own NDA on departure January 2016 and received severance characterized as 'over $172,000 between October 2016 and September 2017'; (f) Tim Parlatore (the primary subject of this investigation) was Hegseth's attorney for the CVA severance/NDA matter and is quoted: 'They make EVERYONE who leaves CVA sign an NDA. It was standard for all employees.' This places Parlatore in the Hegseth attorney role at minimum from the time of the CVA departure in 2016 — earlier than the 2017 Monterey assault matter previously documented (finding 10807).
